catalog.title: Objects with a world inside
catalog.description: Explore the Ego Hygiene store: independent designs, music-inspired collections, and objects with a story.
catalog.kicker: Art. Music. Things to carry with you.
catalog.heading: Objects with a world inside.
catalog.introduction: Some begin with a song. Some with a feeling. A home for designs that become part of your everyday world.
catalog.footnote: Made of stories. Open to becoming.
catalog.standalone: A feeling, standing on its own
catalog.previewDescription: The store is in preview; nothing is available to purchase yet. Sample entries are fictional and labelled in their descriptions.
catalog.pathwaysHeading: Find a world. Or make your own.
catalog.pathwaysDescription: Stories to enter. Designs to live with.
catalog.independentDescription: A design can have a life of its own. Discover its artwork and the objects it could become.
catalog.browseDescription: Wear it. Hold it. Step into it.
catalog.emptyHeading: A little quiet on this frequency.
catalog.emptyDescription: No entries match your search. Try a different phrase or explore everything.
catalog.featureKicker: A song can become a place
catalog.featureDescription: Follow a thread from the artwork to the objects it lives on. Each collection is a small world of its own.
catalog.worldsKicker: One home. Room for many worlds.
catalog.worldsHeading: A feeling doesn’t need a category.
catalog.worldsDescription: Ego Hygiene is the home for this store. Some designs will grow from its own realm; others will find their place through music, characters, and independent collections.
catalog.worldsCommunity: There’s room here for Incompris LLC artists, including .play(), and for something that simply felt worth making.
catalog.worldsNote: Artist collections are still taking shape. Demo entries are fictional and do not represent an artist release.
catalog.signoff: Keep a little of your world with you.
